watchdog_orgs_searched: Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN)
adversarial_framing_notes: General/Macro Press sweep surfaced the Houthi-Saudi security escalation as the dominant in-window geopolitical story. Adversarial (Saudi-as-aggressor) framing checked across additional outlets: it exists, concentrated in Press TV (Iranian state media, 24 Sep) and, out of window (18-22 Sep), Al Jazeera, Middle East Eye and Al-Monitor relaying Houthi claims of Saudi airstrikes on Yemen. The only strictly in-window aggressor-framing items were from Press TV, which is not an eligible listed outlet, so no separate Negative Articles bullet was cited from it; the check was run and recorded.
notes: First real edition (do-not-reuse register empty).
